claims.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Lake Geneva in Lausanne.

findings.quote: Our setting on the shores of Lake Geneva in Lausanne is a natural idyll where lake meets mountains.

claims.text: The hotel has four restaurants and two bars.

findings.quote: Stir your senses in one of our four restaurants and two bars.
Four restaurants. Two bars. A summer restaurant.

claims.text: Kaigan serves Japanese cuisine made with authentic Japanese techniques, from sushi to teppanyaki, with sake.

findings.quote: prepared with authentic Japanese techniques, from sushis to Teppanyaki, served with precision, honoured with a glass of sake.

claims.text: Café Beau-Rivage serves brasserie classics and has an outdoor terrace looking onto the lake.

findings.quote: Take a seat at our scenic outdoor terrace to gaze on the lake or settle into the splendour of our dining room to enjoy brasserie classics

claims.text: La Terrasse serves a breakfast buffet with views of Lake Geneva.

findings.quote: Rise and shine with a gourmet breakfast buffet of fresh, nourishing dishes, all served with front-row views of legendary Lake Geneva.

claims.text: The Guerlain Spa has heated indoor and outdoor pools.

findings.quote: a hairdressing studio, as well as heated indoor and outdoor pools.

claims.text: The spa's changing areas include a hammam, sauna, ice cave and ice fountain.

findings.quote: two changing areas with hammam, sauna, ice cave and ice fountain

claims.text: Guerlain created an exclusive Beau-Rivage Palace fragrance for the hotel.

findings.quote: Discover the exclusive Beau-Rivage Palace Fragrance created by Guerlain for the hotel

claims.text: Palace Junior Suites open onto balconies at the front of the hotel, with views of Lake Geneva.

findings.quote: Perfectly poised to take in the magnificent views of Lake Geneva, our Palace Junior Suites spill out onto showstopping, hotel-front balconies

claims.text: The Spa Suite has its own private Guerlain spa with a hammam, steam shower and hot tub.

findings.quote: a private Guerlain spa with hammam, a steam shower, a hot tub and massage area

claims.text: The Panoramic Suite has a roof terrace with views of Ouchy, the lakefront and the Alps.

findings.quote: Ascending to a roof terrace for gazing at the stars, this stylish pad offers giddy views of Ouchy, the lakefront and the Alps.

claims.text: In 2026 the hotel received a score of 100/100 in the Falstaff Hotel Guide.

findings.quote: In 2026, the Beau-Rivage Palace received a score of 100/100 in the Falstaff Hotel Guide.

claims.text: Beau-Rivage Palace opened in 1861 as a grand hotel on the Quais d'Ouchy in Lausanne.

findings.quote: In 1861, a grand hotel on the Quais d’Ouchy opened its doors and ushered in a new era of luxury in Lausanne. This is the story of Beau-Rivage Palace.

claims.text: The Guerlain Spa covers 1,500 square metres.

findings.quote: Across 1,500 square metres, the spa brings together one elegant suite for two

claims.text: The Imperial Suite has one of the largest private hotel terraces in Switzerland.

findings.quote: With one of the largest private hotel terraces in Switzerland, this majestic suite offers entrancing views of Lake Geneva and the Alps

claims.text: La Rotonde, a dome, connects the two halves of the building.

findings.quote: the magnificent dome—La Rotonde, now the connecting feature between two halves of the building

claims.text: The spa's private Suite Orchidée Impériale has a Japanese bath for two and a private hammam.

findings.quote: In this private space, you’ll find a Japanese bath for two, private hammam, massage tables and a welcome glass of champagne.

claims.text: The hotel is a 45-minute drive from Geneva International Airport.

findings.quote: 45 minutes’ drive from Geneva International Airport

claims.text: Sister properties Hôtel Angleterre and Château d'Ouchy, a short walk away, have their own restaurants; those venues are not inside Beau-Rivage Palace.

findings.quote: Just a short walk away from Beau-Rivage Palace you’ll find our sister properties Hôtel Angleterre and Château d’Ouchy, each with their own delicious eating and drinking experiences to savour.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers.
